# Tiny Home Permit

> Tiny Home Permit (part of GetMyPermit) helps people in Western Australia get approval for tiny homes: local government approval for tiny homes on wheels (treated as caravans) and building permits for fixed tiny homes.

## Pages

- [Tiny home approvals in WA, sorted.](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/): Need approval for a tiny home in Perth or WA? We handle council approvals for tiny homes on wheels (up to 24 months) and building permits for fixed tiny homes.
- [Tiny homes on wheels: the WA rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-on-wheels-rules-wa): The rules for living in a tiny home on wheels in WA: treated as a caravan, council approval for up to 24 months since September 2024, conditions and decks.
- [Fixed tiny home permits in WA](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/fixed-tiny-home-permit): A tiny home on footings or a slab is a building in WA and needs a building permit. How the granny flat rules apply, modular tiny homes, and what we prepare.
- [Applying to your council for a tiny home](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-council-application): How to apply to your WA council for a tiny home on wheels: what goes in the application, the services councils check, timeframes and renewing your approval.
- [Does a tiny home on wheels need to be registered in WA?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-registration-wa): Registering a tiny home on wheels in WA: why councils care, the inspection and VL17 steps, the $7.44 per 100 kg caravan fee, and what registration doesn't do.
- [How long can I live in a tiny home on wheels?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-stay-calculator): Free tool: find out how long you can live in a tiny home on wheels in WA. 5 nights without approval, up to 24 months with council approval, and the rules.
- [Can you have more than one tiny home on your land?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/more-than-one-tiny-home): More than one tiny home on your land in WA: the one-caravan-per-lot rule, council vs Minister approval, the $2,000 fine, the wheels rule and fixed tiny homes.
- [How much does tiny home approval cost in WA?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-approval-cost): What tiny home approval costs in WA: council fees for tiny homes on wheels, the 5-night and 24-month rules, and building permit fees for fixed tiny homes.
- [City of Swan tiny home rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/city-of-swan-tiny-homes): Living in a tiny home in the City of Swan: the temporary accommodation application, what you need, registration, bushfire rules, and fixed tiny homes.
- [How to buy a second-hand tiny home safely](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/buying-second-hand-tiny-home): Buying a used tiny home in WA? Seven checks before you pay: a $2 PPSR search, VIN and paperwork, inspection, and whether council will let you live in it.
- [Shire of Serpentine-Jarrahdale tiny home rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/shire-of-serpentine-jarrahdale-tiny-homes): Serpentine-Jarrahdale tiny home rules: development approval after 5 days in 28, 24-month approvals for homes on wheels, and the 100 m² limit and building rules for fixed tiny homes.
- [Can you live in a caravan on your own land in WA?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/live-in-caravan-on-own-land-wa): Living in a caravan on your own land in WA: up to 5 nights with the owner's OK, up to 24 months with council approval, conditions councils set, and Minister approvals.
- [Is my tiny home a caravan or a building?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/caravan-or-building-checker): Free checker: find out if your WA tiny home counts as a caravan, a park home or a building, and what that means for permits and how long you can live in it.
- [What are the new tiny home laws in WA?](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/new-tiny-home-laws-wa): The tiny home rules in WA explained: 2024 R-Codes changes, the 5 night and 24 month rules for homes on wheels, Minister approvals, and permits for fixed tiny homes.
- [Tiny home prices in Perth (2026)](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-prices-perth): Tiny homes in Perth are advertised from about $26,500 to $192,800 in 2026. What's included, delivery and site costs, and the approval fees for homes on wheels and on footings.
- [Tiny home on wheels vs fixed tiny home](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/wheels-vs-fixed-tiny-home): In WA a tiny home on wheels is a caravan and a fixed tiny home is a house. Approvals, how long you can stay, the building code, size limits and which suits you.
- [How to move a tiny home onto your land](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/moving-a-tiny-home): Moving a tiny home onto your land in WA: the approvals you need first, the 2.5 m wide and 4.3 m high road limits, site access, cranes, the pad and connecting services.
- [Shire of Mundaring tiny home rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/shire-of-mundaring-tiny-homes): Shire of Mundaring tiny home rules in plain English: 5 nights in 28 days on wheels, up to 2 years while you build, and approving a fixed tiny home as a house or granny flat.
- [Guides](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to tiny homes approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for tiny homes in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Tiny home on wheels from $1,450.
